summary.text: Levon Stilson is the Republican candidate for Colorado State Senate District 11 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the Republican primary on June 30, 2026.
He served in the U.S. Army from 2013 to 2022 and has worked in construction.

paragraphs.text: Levon Stilson said in a Ballotpedia survey that he was born in Colorado and enlisted in the U.S. Army at 17, where he was assigned to the Old Guard and conducted full honors funerals as a casket bearer.
He later served with the 4th Infantry Division at Fort Carson and deployed to Afghanistan with the 2nd Brigade, 2-12 Infantry Battalion.

After being honorably discharged in 2022, Stilson said, he enrolled at the University of Colorado Colorado Springs to study political science and history, and worked as a legislative aide in the Colorado State Legislature while attending school full time.
In the same survey, Stilson listed three campaign messages: affordability, protecting civil liberties and public safety.

On affordability, he said he would work to reduce regulations on businesses and defend TABOR; on public safety, he said he would support law enforcement and first responders and hold violent offenders accountable.
